notes.title: 🧈 Bread & Butter – Patch Notes
notes.notes:
🆕 New Duo: Lord Crumbula & Garly

Meet our newest Bread & Butter pair!

🍞 Lord Crumbula

    Starts with a unique item: Breadborne

        Heals the player when standing inside a bleed explosion

🧄 Garly (Companion)

    Prioritizes enemies already bleeding

    On contact, instantly triggers a bleed explosion, regardless of stack count (if > 0)

    If no bleeding enemies exist, Garly performs a Blood Sacrifice:

        Sacrifices money to transform into a bat

        In bat form, seeks out the first non-bleeding enemy and applies bleed stacks

        If no money is available, 1 HP from the player is used instead

        Health

        Damage

        Spawn Rate

    Want an easier run? Set the values negative!

    Want to suffer? Crank them up!

Plenty more to come — but for now...

notes.title: Bread & Butter Patch Notes
notes.notes:
⚔️ New Weapons

    🥩 Skewer (Melee):

        Impales enemies in a line.

        Limited number of enemies can be impaled at once (increases with tier).

        Impaled enemies bleed out over time.

        Added base impale chance.

    ♻️ Recycler:

        Absorbs enemies (capacity and enemy size based on tier).

        Converts absorbed enemies into projectiles.

        Launches automatically when fully loaded.

        Projectiles scale with % of enemy max HP.

🩸 New Bleed System

    Bleed Explosion Stack Threshold:

        Each successful bleed applies a stack.

        If enough stacks are applied during a single bleed duration, the target explodes, damaging nearby enemies.

        Bleed explosions apply new bleed stacks to affected enemies.

        Surplus stacks beyond threshold also apply.
